steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Very well. I will retrieve the Monolith files from my room.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: Helene and I can gather bedding and see what other provisions we can salvage.
(Black Screen)
After some time, the group has settled, each person creating a makeshift bed on the main hall's floor.
A perimeter of distrust is silently established. Individuals space themselves apart but ensure they remain visible to all.
Hilda then wheels out the Monolith prototype, centering it in the hall.
You realize that, aside from yourself, everyone else is witnessing the actual "Monolith" for the first time.

It stands waist-high, a black metal box reminiscent of a small coffin. Four screens are set into its sides, each with a corresponding keyboard. Its inner workings are partially exposed; within the unassembled core, a cluster of electronic dials glimmers faintly under the lights.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Can I have your assistance to complete the final calibration process?

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: Ah... of course. I was beginning to think you'd forgotten why you brought an old cryptographer along in the first place.

steps.speaker: Helene
steps.content: No trouble at all. After all, the Monolith is the entire reason we're all here, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: My expertise with mechanical systems isn't on par with Huck's, but I can manage the radio components.
Hilda nods and hands out a stack of documents to everyone present.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: The final calibration requires extensive parallel calculations and data entry. Please review your assigned documents thoroughly, then input the data accurately into the corresponding Monolith modules.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Notify me immediately of any interface discrepancies or hardware errors during the process. I will make the necessary adjustments.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: Hmm... I see now... So this is the Monolith... truly an elegant design.
Leaning over the most confidential Monolith schematics, Manphist lets out a series of impressed clicks of his tongue, absorbing every detail of the revolutionary design.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: Not purely mechanical rotors, but integrated with the latest computing technology... hmm... yet it still contains twelve interconnected rotors internally. On demand, several can generate false data to mislead the enemy, while its cyclical structure renders brute-force decryption utterly useless...

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: If we had had this device back then, our intelligence network would not have been so thoroughly annihilated.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: Augustus, that anomalous power wielder from DisCity... as long as she knows the strike coordinates in advance, her incomprehensible power can intercept anything... This alone stripped us of every effective deterrent we had.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: And that ghostly Reaper unit... always appearing where we were most vulnerable, tearing our defensive lines to shreds...

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: But now... No matter. It is not too late.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Once DisCity can no longer decrypt our messages, Augustus will lose her strategic advantage.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ${PlayerName}... I need you to take the night watch.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Though everything lies in ruins around us... this is the final push.

options: I'd like to help with the Monolith calculations as well.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Thank you. I'm counting on you to keep watch.

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: You're versed in the ciphers too? Very well. I can share some of my work with you.
(Paths converge)

Everyone gathers around the Monolith and gets to work, the air filled with the quiet intensity of their calculations.
It's going to be a sleepless night.
